card.name: Punctuation before year in citations
card.fires_on: The space, period, comma or opening parenthesis right after an author's name or initials in a reference list, just before the publication year.

modes.label: Space or parenthesis before year
modes.description: The gap or opening bracket between the last author and the year.
modes.example: Yang, C.S., et al.<< >>2000. Tea and tea

modes.label: Period or comma after initials
modes.description: The punctuation after an author's initial inside a citation.
modes.example: Cannatella, D<<.>> C., and L. Trueb.

card.plain: It fires in reference lists at the spot after an author's name where the year is about to come.
